items.name: Barby Cube 2019

venue.name: Ecole élémentaire
venue.address: Ecole élémentaire, Place de la Mairie, 73230 Barby, France
venue.details: In the School's gymnasium - Dans le gymnase de l'école

items.information:
Vous n'êtes pas obligé d'arriver au moment de l'enregistrement, nous vous accepterons sans aucun problème si vous arrivez dans la journée. Essayez simplement d'être là au moins 30 minutes avant votre première épreuve.
Une pièce d'identité vous sera demandée si c'est votre première compétition.
**Merci de nous prévenir par e-mail si finalement vous ne pouvez pas participer à la compétition.**

**REPAS** :
Les samedi soir et dimanche soir, nous vous proposons un repas collectif et des jeux, sur le lieu de la compétition.
Samedi soir, pour 10€ : 
* Des diots (saucisse de porc Savoyarde) et des crozets (une alternative végétarienne/végétalienne devrait être disponible, merci de nous le préciser)
* Un dessert, incluant des gourdes de compote de pomme ou des fruits, un yaourt et peut-être un gateau

Dimanche soir pour 15€ : 
* Une grande pizza (au choix, commande le jour J)
* Un dessert, comme le samedi

**LASER GAME** :
Le samedi soir, nous allons au Laser Game ensemble, nous arrangerons les voitures avec les personnes présentes. Nous avons la grande salle, de 21h50 à minuit pour 2 parties de 45 minutes. Vous pouvez participer aux deux pour 28€ (à régler au Laser Game) ou une pour 15€.
Merci de préciser dans la section "Commentaire" de votre inscription si vous comptez venir, et si vous êtes accompagnés, car il y a un nombre limité de places ! 

---
You are not obliged to be here at registration time, we will accept you if you come during the day. Try to be here at least 30 minutes before your first event.
We'll ask for an ID if it's your first competition.
**Please send us an email if you cannot participate after all.**

**DINNERS**:
On Saturday and Sunday evening, we propose a dinner all together, and games, at the competition venue.
Saturday evening for 10€:
* "Diots" (Savoyarde pork saussage) et "crozets" (a bit like pasta) (a vegetarian/vegan alternative should be availble, please ask us)
* A dessert, including an apple jam or fruits, a yogurt and maybe a cake

Sunday evening for 15€:
* A big pizza (to be chosen on the day)
* A dessert, like on Saturday

**LASER GAME**:
On saturday night we will go to play Laser Game together, we'll arrange shuttles with the cars available. We will have the main room from 21h50 to midnight for two 45 minute games. You can play in both for 28€ (to pay at the Laser Game) or one for 15€.
Please mention in the "Comment" section of your registration to the competition if you're coming and if you are alone or with guests. There are limited spots!

items.information:
(CG)

Montenegro Nationals je treće takmičenje po redu koje se održava u Crnoj Gori od 2017. godine. Bilo ko može učestvovati, bez obzira na nacionalnost i starost, no svako mora biti upoznat s WCA Pravilnikom.

Takmičenje je priznato kao Nacionalno Prvenstvo Crne Gore za 2019. te će se dijeliti nagrade za najbolja 3 takmičara iz Crne Gore u svim disciplinama.

---

(EN)

Montenegro Nationals 2019 is the 3rd speedcubing competition being held in Montenegro since 2017. Anyone can participate, no matter which nationality or age they are, but they need to be familiar with the WCA Regulations.

This competition is also recognized as Montenegrin National Championship and top 3 Montenegrins in all events will be additionally awarded, alongside regular podiums.

items.name: GLS Cup IV 2019
items.information:
GLS Cup 2019 is a series of 5 official WCA competitions in Gdańsk (Northern Poland). GLS is combining 5 competitions into one ranking system including:
- General classification of all events
- 3x3x3 classification for kids,
- 3x3x3 for parents 
- 3x3x3 Fewest Moves League
At the main venue we have big rollup banner with the names of GLS Record holders. It is our tradition to refresh the names after each record. After the first day we host cubers integration. Next to the hotel we have parking area and shop.
If you want to join us, you are most welcome!

items.name: Veterans Day Open 2019

venue.name: Discovery Canyon Campus
venue.address: 1810 North Gate Blvd, Colorado Springs, CO 80921, USA
venue.details: PK-8 Cafeteria. Park near and enter through the PK-5 Entrance and follow signs. Same venue as Pikes Peak 2019.

items.information:
We are happy to welcome everyone back to Colorado Springs for the third time this year, as we come together for a charitable cause! 

All are welcome to attend.

Please note that this competition can only accomodate 85 competitors. We also ask that guests are kept to a minimum to ensure enough room for competitors. Be sure to register early to guarantee a spot in the competition!

All proceeds will go to benefit the [Cincinnati Children’s Hospital Proton Therapy Center](https://www.cincinnatichildrens.org/service/p/proton-therapy) as well as the [Bold and Brave Kid's Foundation](http://boldandbravekids.org/). Extra donations will be accepted in the registration phase, and at the competition. No refunds of registration fees will be offered under any circumstance. *All registration fees will still go to benefit the Cincinnati Children’s Hospital Proton Therapy Center and the Bold and Brave Kids Foundation.*

items.name: No Place For DNF Fall 2019
items.information:
All proceeds from the competition will be donated to the No Place for Hate® club of Emmaus High School. Proceeds will not be donated to ADL directly. 

-We recommend that you arrive at least 15 minutes before your first event because there are no set times for each group. If your first event is later in the day, you do not have to arrive until then. If you miss your group, you will be disqualified from that event.

-Groups will be posted and sent in an email a few days before the competition. When it is time to compete, groups will be called instead of individual participants.

-Food and drinks are **NOT** permitted inside the main room.  You may eat in the cafeteria next door.There are a few restaurants within a ten minute drive. 

-Live results will be posted on cubecomps.com.

-Proceeds from the competition will be donated to the No Place for Hate® club of Emmaus High School and #TeamJack. Proceeds will not be donated to ADL directly.

-CubeDepot will sponsor the competition and will be a vendor!

**A local newspaper photographer will be taking pictures of the competition. If you would not like to have your picture taken, please let us know.**

**Please observe silence during FMC and blindfold events.**

items.name: Albany Fall 2019
items.information:
This competition is being held in part as a fundraiser for the Class of 2020 for Albany High School, and a portion of the proceeds of the competition will go towards the class fund.

Some cell service providers may not have service in the Albany area, so there is a possiblility GPS systems may not work properly, and a set of printed directions may be useful to have on hand when navigating to the school. The school will have WiFi available at the venue, although this has become slightly bogged down in the past due to the large number of people accessing it.
